source_snapshot.test_set: AMD CPU RAS -PCIe LCRC TX/RX Error
source_snapshot.procedure: Calls for ECC RDIMM and NIC, lists PCIe slots, then uses the same fixed 0:0:1/core3/port0 tuple for errortype 0 TX and 1 RX while enabling uncorrectable severity and SyncFlood controls.
source_snapshot.criteria: Correctable tool PASS and OS report within undefined timeout per unspecified AMD RAS spec.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; broad grep merges LCRC, ECRC, poison and fatal classes and supplies no OCP interface, traffic or directional counter oracle.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: RPUC/CHANGED; adds OCP NIC mapping and operator gates but leaves module/service identity, TX/RX observing side, fixed tuple and exact replay evidence unresolved.
source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 Hardware required: RDIMM with ECC Plug a NIC (Network Interface Card) device on a target PCIe slot on the SUT / HDT Software tool: AMD RAS Error Injection Tool 1. BIOS settings: a. NBIO Common options → ACS Enable: Enable b. NBIO Common options → Enable AER Cap: Enable c. AMD PBS → RAS → Pcie Root Port UnCorr Error Sev Reg: 7EF6030 d. AMD PBS → RAS → Pcie Device UnCorr Error Sev Reg: 7EF6030 e. FCH Common Options → FCH RAS Options → Reset After Sync-Flood: Enable f. NBIO Common Options → NBIO RAS Common Options → SyncFlood on PCIe Fatal Error: True 2. Unlock CPU via HDT. 3. Boot into Ubuntu 20.04/RHEL 2022. 4. Download the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool, then install and open the software. 5. Execute the following command to get a list of devices in the PCIe slots: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --listpcieslotinfo 6. PCIe LCRC TX Error, enter the following commands: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --pcieerror --sockdienbio 0:0:1 --errortype 0 --pciecore 3 --pcieport 0 7. PCIe LCRC RX Error, enter the following commands: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --pcieerror --sockdienbio 0:0:1 --errortype 1 --pciecore 3 --pcieport 0 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. For correctable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 3. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed. 4. Follow the AMD RAS Spec to check the dmesg and Error inject report.
source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: PARTIAL | -- OCP slot 1~N: inject the PCIe LCRC on OCP slot 1~N via the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool (after HDT/unlock + the BIOS RAS knobs from the procedure, e.g. Platform First Error Handling=Enabled + per-unit MCA/UMC settings). Agent stages/verifies with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "dmesg -T 2>&1 | tail -160 | grep -iE 'pcier|aer|ecrc|lcrc|poisoned|fatal'; echo __PCIe_LCRC_on_OCP_slot_1~N; ipmitool sel elist 2>&1 | tail -40 2>&1" but the tool injection step itself is interactive/HW-level and needs the user to drive the exact inject command.

test_case.test_name: OCP slot 1~N — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Verify correctable LCRC handling in transmit and receive directions for every required OCP slot, demonstrating directional replay/counter evidence while preserving the OCP interface and its dependent services.
required_package: OCP slot/module serial/FW/driver/interface/BDF to socket/die/NBIO/core/port map for all targets
Distinct coverage versus PCIe row 61 and management/storage/fabric service dependencies
Vendor proof errortype 0/1 means LCRC TX/RX and which endpoint observes each error
Disposable bidirectional traffic and direction-specific link/AER/NIC counter plus packet oracle
Decoded 7EF6030 relevance, masks, DPC and SyncFlood policy for correctable LCRC
Supported OS, timeout, replay/retrain thresholds, aborts, independent OOB recovery and restoration
test_case.test_command: Inventory each OCP module, firmware, driver, interface, service dependency and PCIe-to-NBIO/core/port path; prove errortype direction semantics and identify observer; establish independent OOB management; run disposable bidirectional traffic; baseline link/AER/NIC counters; inject TX and RX separately; correlate directional status and packet outcome; verify no fatal escalation, link downgrade or service loss; restore BIOS/HDT/AER state.
test_case.expected_result: 1. For correctable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 3. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed. 4. Follow the AMD RAS Spec to check the dmesg and Error inject report.

safety_gate: Dedicated OCP path with OOB management independent of the tested interface and no production traffic
Power/ESD-safe module handling and live path verification; do not copy the PCIe companion tuple
Baseline service health and counters under controlled directional traffic before one stimulus
Abort on wrong interface/counter, service loss, link downgrade, excessive loss, driver reset or fatal escalation
No automatic retry; preserve evidence and restore/diff BIOS/HDT/AER/SyncFlood and module state
expected_evidence: Exact OCP module/interface/service and NBIO/core/port identity
Approved errortype direction map, decoded policy and baseline directional counters
Disposable traffic endpoints/direction with packet/checksum baseline
Separate TX/RX transcripts and attributable replay/status/counter deltas
No fatal escalation, link downgrade or persistent interface/service impact
test_case.recovery: If the OCP module is the sole management or cluster-control path, retain execution as pending until an independent channel and traffic-isolation plan exist. Lack of directional counters requires an approved analyzer, not a generic dmesg substitute.

source_conflict.reason: OCP slot 1~N uses the same fixed tuple as PCIe row 61 with no module/interface/service or distinct-coverage map. TX/RX flags lack authority, ECC RDIMM is unexplained, logs mix unrelated errors, and no directed traffic/counter oracle exists. Correctable Criteria coexist with undecoded uncorrectable severity/SyncFlood controls; timeout is undefined and RHEL 2022 ambiguous.
